title: Fix CMP-001 revision items: double IncrementTurn + dead assertion in breaker test

findings.claim: Double IncrementTurn per tool-use iteration halves the MinTurnsCooldown=2 death-spiral guard: the CMP-001 block calls engine.autoTracker.IncrementTurn() (~line 138 of internal/query/provider_tools_loop.go) while the loop already incremented per iteration near lines 281-283 (at 4a7dc99). After a compaction at iteration k, two increments land within that iteration, unblocking re-trigger at k+1. Verify by reading both call sites; write a RED test proving a compaction can re-trigger on the immediately following iteration, then fix by removing exactly one increment site.

Dead assertion in internal/query/autocompact_test.go breaker test: the guard `if len(store.Snapshot().Conversation.Messages) <= len(conv.Messages)` is always false (the conversation grows well past 6 originals), so the bigText-preservation check inside never executes. Rewrite so the assertion actually runs and can fail.

title: Fix CMP-001 session-persistence desync: compacted conversation resurrects on resume + first post-compaction exchange lost; also swallowed user prompt on compaction fire

findings.claim: Auto-compaction replaces store.Conversation.Messages but never rewrites the session; the incremental writer (run.go makeSessionSaveClose, lastIdx) then skips the summary + first post-compaction exchange, and on --resume the full pre-compaction history replays, resurrecting the exact 345k blowup. Manual /compact already returns RewriteSession:true (internal/slash/commands.go ~153-177, rewriteCurrentSession run.go ~2099-2131); the auto path needs an equivalent.

When compaction fires at the top of an iteration, the just-appended unanswered user prompt is compacted away and never reaches the model (CompactUserMessage returns bare summary with suppressFollowUp=false); the pending prompt must be preserved or re-injected.

title: critic finding: Porting the trigger to unscoped pragma-loop runs activates auto-compaction on forked orchestration persistent-state engines

payload.claim: Porting the trigger to unscoped pragma-loop runs activates auto-compaction on forked orchestration persistent-state engines that inherit the ROOT's compaction deps: a fork's compaction rewrites the ROOT's session file (rewriting root store + resetting root SessionLastIdx via the inherited SessionRewrite closure), shares the root's AutoTracker so fork failures trip the session-wide breaker for the root, and compacts via the root's provider/model even after the fork rebinds a persona provider — none of this is tested or documented beyond the generic CMP-001.4 F5 note; the leak was dormant before this commit
payload.evidence: internal/orchestration/runner.go:348,961 (persistent states fork + unscoped IncludePriorConversation); internal/query/engine.go:181-183 (fork shares compactor/autoTracker/windowConfig; subCfg := engine.config copies SessionRewrite closure); internal/query/miniswe_loop.go:370,431 (gate passes on fork; fork rewriteSession); internal/cli/run.go:2112,2131 (rewriteCurrentSession snapshots the ROOT d.Store and resets root SessionLastIdx); internal/compact/auto.go:43-48 (shared breaker, no un-trip); internal/orchestration/runner.go:864 (BindProvider rebinds fork provider, compactor still root's)

title: critic finding: Moving IncrementTurn inside the scope gate means scoped main-loop iterations (orchestration state runs on shared-tracker eng

payload.claim: Moving IncrementTurn inside the scope gate means scoped main-loop iterations (orchestration state runs on shared-tracker engines) no longer advance the shared AutoTracker, while the FinalTextOnly sub-loop's increment stays unconditional — the claimed 'one IncrementTurn per model-request iteration' invariant is false for scoped iterations and the two sub-paths of the same function now have opposite increment semantics; undocumented drift (safe direction: only delays re-compaction)
payload.evidence: internal/query/miniswe_loop.go:370,442 (increment now inside len(run.MessageStartIndexes)==0 gate) vs removed unconditional site at git show 1b4fb1b^:internal/query/miniswe_loop.go lines ~370-374; internal/query/miniswe_loop.go:315 (FinalTextOnly increment still unconditional)
